titleZh: 编码 Agent 之年：当 Claude Code 作者自己 30 天没写一行代码——Zvi 周报 #149 精选
titleEn: AI #149: The Age of the Coding Agent
author: Zvi Mowshowitz
authorTitle: 《Don't Worry About the Vase》主笔，AI 周报作者
summary: Zvi 周报 149「编码 Agent 之年」：Claude Code 作者 30 天 0 行手写代码。
keyPoints: **代码不再是瓶颈成为自述**：Claude Code 作者晒 259 PR/4 万行 100% 由 Opus 4.5 写；落后一个月认知就过时。
**比较优势的安慰会自我证伪**：当替代旧工作的新知识工作也由 AI 完成，Jevons 悖论对知识工作只在曲线左侧成立。
**芯片与监管两条暗线**：放行 H200 对华销售被指用 2-3 年战略领先换股市一时亢奋，监管拉锯抬升风险。
insight: 最大杠杆不是招更多工程师，而是让现有团队掌握 agent 编排那层新抽象。

bilingual.en:
Claude Code has reached the point where creator Boris Cherny stopped writing code.

Boris Cherny: ...In the last thirty days, I landed 259 PRs -- 497 commits, 40k lines added, 38k lines removed. Every single line was written by Claude Code + Opus 4.5. Claude consistently runs for minutes, hours, and days at a time (using Stop hooks). Software engineering is changing, and we are entering a new period in coding history. And we're still just getting started.

In the last thirty days, 100% of my contributions to Claude Code were written by Claude Code.
bilingual.zh:
Claude Code 已经发展到，连它的创造者 Boris Cherny 自己都不写代码了。

Boris Cherny：……过去 30 天里，我提交了 259 个 PR——497 次 commit，新增 4 万行、删除 3.8 万行。每一行都由 Claude Code + Opus 4.5 写成。Claude 能持续运行数分钟、数小时、甚至数天（借助 Stop hooks）。软件工程正在改变，我们正进入编码历史的一个新阶段。而这才刚刚开始。

过去 30 天里，我对 Claude Code 这个项目 100% 的贡献，都是由 Claude Code 写的。

bilingual.en:
Andrej Karpathy: I've never felt this much behind as a programmer. The profession is being dramatically refactored as the bits contributed by the programmer are increasingly sparse and between... There's a new programmable layer of abstraction to master... involving agents, subagents, their prompts, contexts, memory, modes, permissions, tools, plugins, skills, hooks, MCP, LSP, slash commands, workflows, IDE integrations...

Clearly some powerful alien tool was handed around except it comes with no manual and everyone has to figure out how to hold it and operate it, while the resulting magnitude 9 earthquake is rocking the profession. Roll up your sleeves to not fall behind.
bilingual.zh:
Andrej Karpathy：作为一名程序员，我从未感到如此落后。这个职业正在被剧烈重构——程序员亲手贡献的那部分代码越来越稀疏、越来越零星……有一整层全新的可编程抽象需要掌握……涉及 agent、subagent，以及它们的 prompt、上下文、记忆、模式、权限、工具、插件、skills、hooks、MCP、LSP、斜杠命令、工作流、IDE 集成……

显然，有人把一件强大的外星工具传到了每个人手里，却没附说明书——人人都得自己摸索怎么握住它、怎么操作它，与此同时一场 9 级地震正在撼动整个职业。卷起袖子，别掉队。

bilingual.en: Deepfates points out that for $20/month you can get essentially unlimited chat access to one of several amazing digital minds that are constantly getting better (I recommend Claude if you have to pick only one), that this is a huge effective equalizing effect that is democratic and empowering, and if you're not taking advantage of this you should start. Even for $0/month you can get something pretty amazing, you'll be less than a year behind.
bilingual.zh: Deepfates 指出：每月 20 美元，你就能近乎无限地使用若干个持续变强的惊人数字心智之一（如果只能选一个，我推荐 Claude）；这是一种巨大、民主化、赋能式的有效拉平效应，如果你还没用上，就该开始了。哪怕是每月 0 美元的免费档，你也能得到相当惊人的东西——最多落后不到一年。

bilingual.en:
Seb Krier: Unless AGI can do literally everything and becomes abundant enough to meet all demand, it behaves broadly like powerful automation has before: replacing humans in some uses while expanding the production frontier in ways that sustain demand for labour elsewhere.

[Zvi]: Sigh. Among other issues, this very obviously proves too much, right? For example, if this is true, then it shows there cannot possibly be zero marginal product workers today, since clearly human labor cannot meet all demand?... The problem with AI comes when the other new knowledge work to do is also done via AI.
bilingual.zh:
Seb Krier：除非 AGI 真能做字面意义上的一切、并且丰裕到足以满足所有需求，否则它的行为大体和以往的强大自动化一样：在某些用途上替代人类，同时以维持别处劳动需求的方式扩张生产边界。

（Zvi 回应）：唉。撇开其他问题不谈，这显然『证明了太多』，对吧？比如，如果这成立，那就说明今天不可能存在零边际产出的劳动者——因为人类劳动显然无法满足所有需求……AI 带来的真正麻烦，恰恰发生在『那些用来替代旧工作的新知识工作，本身也由 AI 来做』的时候。

bilingual.en:
Charles Foster: The mechanization of agriculture didn't wait for a "drop-in substitute for a field worker". Neither will the mechanization of knowledge work wait for a "drop-in substitute for a remote worker".

[Zvi on Jevons]: As efficiency grows, demand for such labor increases more up until some critical point. Past that point, if we keep going, tasks and jobs become more efficient or taken faster than humans gain employment in new tasks. At the limit, if AI can do all knowledge work sufficiently better, cheaper and faster than humans, this greatly reduces demand for humans doing knowledge work.
bilingual.zh:
Charles Foster：农业机械化并没有等到『田间工人的即插即用替代品』才发生。知识工作的机械化，同样不会等到『远程工作者的即插即用替代品』。

（Zvi 论 Jevons 悖论）：随着效率提升，对这类劳动的需求会先增加，直到某个临界点。越过那个点之后若继续推进，任务和岗位被效率化、或被更快完成的速度，将超过人类在新任务上获得就业的速度。在极限处，如果 AI 能足够好、足够便宜、足够快地完成所有知识工作，那么人类从事知识工作的需求就会大幅下降。

bilingual.en:
Matt Parlmer: The policy decision to allow this is basically a straightforward trade where we give away a 2-3yr strategic competitive advantage in exchange for a somewhat frothier stock market in Q1 2026. Good job guys.

[Zvi]: On the contrary, this is net negative for the stock market. Nvidia gets a small boost, but they were already able to sell all chips they could produce... Every other tech company, indeed every other company, now faces tougher competition from China, so their stocks should decline far more.
bilingual.zh:
Matt Parlmer：允许这件事的政策决定，本质上是一笔直白的交易——我们交出 2-3 年的战略竞争优势，换来 2026 年第一季度一个略微更亢奋的股市。干得好啊各位。

（Zvi）：恰恰相反，这对股市是净负面。英伟达得到的提振很小，因为它本来就能卖光所有能生产的芯片……而其他每一家科技公司、乃至每一家公司，现在都要面对来自中国的更激烈竞争，它们的股价理应跌得多得多。

secondaryReads.pov: 本期最核心的一手证据原帖：Claude Code 创造者亲述 30 天 259 PR、新增 4 万行（净增约 2 千行）全部由 Claude Code + Opus 4.5 写成，并给出关键判断『代码越来越不是瓶颈了』(code is no longer the bottleneck)。相比 Zvi 的转述，原帖更完整地呈现了从 2024 年 9 月『连转义 bash 命令都费劲』到如今『持续运行数小时数天』的能力跃迁曲线。

Zvi 在文中引用的实操指南，提供了与他『宏观判断』互补的『落地视角』：把 Claude Code 当通用工作台而非纯编码工具——下载 YouTube 视频、提升图片质量、扫描会议录音找出自己回避冲突的时刻、在 VS Code 里写全部内容。点破了一个常被忽略的事实：很多能力标准聊天界面也能做，Claude Code 的真正优势是干净的文件访问 + 可配置记忆（配置存在 .md 文本里，能自我改进）。
为本期提供『时间线校准』的冷静第二视角：与 Zvi 同步，他们也因 2025 的进展把时间线整体往后调——Kokotajlo 过去一年把预测拉长约 2 年，Lifland 的超级智能中位数时间线现为 2034、自动化编码者 2032。这与『编码 Agent 之年』的兴奋形成有益对冲：工具层革命极快是真的，但通往 AGI 的终局时间线高度不确定且误差棒很宽，两者不该混为一谈。
